name: High Priestess
ability: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
interaction: Storyteller points to one player (alive or dead, any alignment) of their own choosing. No choice by the player.
drunk_or_poisoned: Storyteller may point to a player who would be unhelpful or misleading to talk to (any player is legal either way).

rulings.text: The same player may be shown on consecutive nights, or a different one each night.
Shown player may be alive or dead, good or evil.

No fixed criteria: the Storyteller picks whoever would most help the High Priestess and the good team (unrevealed info, implausible evil bluff, trustworthy player needing trust, good player on the wrong track).
Examples: shown a Chef with useful info, a Goblin early, a Drunk whose wrong info harms good, a Saint three nights in a row, an Imp whose story clashes.

Night order: High Priestess is absent from the townsquare roles.json scale used for every other spec. The official botc-release nightsheet places her after the Spy and before the General on both nights; on the townsquare scale those are Spy 49 / General 50 (first night) and Spy 68 / General 69 (other nights), so she is given 49.5 and 68.5 to sort between them.

test_scenarios.name: first night shown
test_scenarios.setup: Alice High Priestess, Bob Chef, Carol Imp, Dan Baron.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice wakes on night 1 and is shown Bob.

test_scenarios.name: dead player legal
test_scenarios.setup: Alice High Priestess, Bob Saint (dead), Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is shown Bob; dead players are legal options.

test_scenarios.name: evil player legal and repeat
test_scenarios.setup: Alice High Priestess, Carol Imp, Dan Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Nights 2 and 3: Storyteller picks Carol both nights.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is shown Carol both nights.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned priestess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice High Priestess, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp, Dan Drunk.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Bob poisons Alice; Storyteller picks Dan.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is shown Dan; every player remains a legal option.
